title: cerastium alpinum subsp. glabratum
intro: Cerastium alpinum subsp. glabratum, commonly known as the Alpine Mouse-ear, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the carnation family. This plant is known for its small white or pink flowers and is native to the mountainous regions of Europe. The Alpine Mouse-ear is used in herbal medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving wound healing due to its antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects.
